amazon_match_notes: Exact match on ASIN B0DFCXLTRD: Kondras model 0815 (MPN 0815-ORB, UPC 008678991224), oil-rubbed bronze with outlets, 2-pack.

comparisons.notes: Sold as Nordic Hygge YF-WL-0815-BKG-2, Internet #339422113. Oil-rubbed bronze 2-pack with GFCI outlets, 3 modes and a 100W E26 socket. Model code 0815 matches Kondras; page was buyable with 90-day returns and no out-of-stock notice.
Exact match: Kondras model 0815, Oil-rubbed Bronze-with outlet (2-Pack), condition New, in stock.

writeup: Woot has a new 2-pack of Kondras model 0815 porch lights (MPN 0815-ORB) in oil-rubbed bronze for $47.99. Each fixture includes a built-in GFCI outlet plus motion-sensor and dusk-to-dawn modes, and they take a standard 100W E26 bulb. Home Depot sells the same 0815 design as a Nordic Hygge YF-WL-0815-BKG-2 2-pack for $106.69, and Abunda has the Kondras 0815 2-pack at $108.99, so this is 55 percent below the lowest of those prices and saves about $59. Woot showed at least three left with a limit of three per customer.
